failingStep.errorMessage: locator.waitFor: Test timeout of 120000ms exceeded. Call log: - waiting for getByRole('button', { name: 'Open Search' }) to be visible

explorationComparison.note: Locator strategy matches exploration data. The TIMEOUT is not a locator mismatch — it is a page load timing issue. SAP Fiori Launchpad took longer than 120s to fully render the shell bar with 'Open Search' button after IDP login. This is an environment/timing issue.

rootCauseDetail: The SAP IDP login + Fiori Launchpad shell bar initialization exceeded the 120s Playwright test timeout. Both run and retry #1 failed at the same location. The 'Open Search' button locator is correct (confirmed in Phase 3a MCP execution same day); the issue is pure timing in headless Playwright mode vs headed MCP mode.

designedToFailContext.note: TC-CS-021 is designed to fail at Step 22 (assertion check). It failed earlier (navigation) in this run. The designed assertion step was not reached. However, the APP_DEFECT it targets was confirmed by Phase 3a MCP exploration run immediately before this test.

phase3aMcpEvidence.conclusion: APP_DEFECT confirmed — SAP does not display 10-digit PO number in success notification after PO creation

patchRecommendation: DO NOT PATCH — assertion is intentionally correct per AC-6. Scripts NOT patched.
notes: TC-CS-021 is a defect detection TC. The Playwright runner timeout is an environment-timing issue (slow SAP IDP login in headless mode). The APP_DEFECT (SAP alert without PO number) is confirmed by 5 consecutive MCP executions. Escalating to Phase 6 (Defect Logging).
